UDP-9 is a straight-blowback AR-9 pistol-caliber carbine. It features a number of AR-15–style components while chambered for 9?19 mm ammunition. The weapon accepts standard 9 mm GLOCK magazines, with the bolt locking open after the last round. 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]Add-ons: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Optics: sights compatible with Picatinny/Weaver rails. 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Suppressor: GemTech

UDP-9-SD is a carbine variant equipped with an integrated suppressor, optimized for subsonic ammunition. It is designed for quiet operation and reduced muzzle signature in close-quarters engagements. 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]Add-ons:
